content.short: Family is a self-custody Ethereum wallet focused on a simple, well-designed experience.
content.description: Family is a self-custody Ethereum wallet known for its design-led approach, from the team that also builds the ConnectKit wallet connection library. World's official World Chain ecosystem directory lists Family Wallet among the wallets supporting the network. Its focus is making self-custody feel approachable rather than technical.
content.meta: Family is a design-led self-custody Ethereum wallet, listed as supporting World Chain.
